content: If diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) fail to heal despite the application of standard wound care protocols, the use of adjunctive advanced therapies should be considered. These therapies are most effectively implemented under the guidance of an interprofessional team of healthcare providers. Once the ulcers have healed, patients should be enrolled in a comprehensive prevention program. This program is designed to minimize the risk of recurrent ulcers and to prevent potential amputations.
